title: Exhibit reset with split object-target knowledge
task_instruction:
Reset the home as a small exhibit area. As a team, complete all of the following:

1) Put the correct glass onto the laundry-room table.
2) Put the vase on the living-room table.
3) Put the picture frame on the dining-room counter.
4) Leave the correct bedroom-1 chest of drawers open at the end.

Room access and communication are restricted, so use your messages carefully and avoid guessing which glass or which drawer is intended.
